name: XAUUSD_MOMENTUM_REVERSAL

entry_rules.hypothesis: Momentum-reversal. Fade extreme momentum: identify M5 bars with small body / range ratio (exhaustion), combine with pin bar detection. Enter in reversal direction (bullish pin bar with long lower shadow -> BUY, bearish pin bar with long upper shadow -> SELL). Confirmed by M15 ADX >= min_adx and EMA trend context.

entry_trigger.condition: Pin bar pattern + momentum exhaustion (body/range in bottom X%)
entry_trigger.buy: Bullish pin bar (long lower shadow > 2x body) + exhaustion + M5 close > EMA20
entry_trigger.sell: Bearish pin bar (long upper shadow > 2x body) + exhaustion + M5 close < EMA20

description: V7: momentum-reversal. Fades extreme momentum using pin bar + exhaustion detection, confirmed by ADX+EMA context. A different DIRECTION from V1-V5 (fade vs ride).

research_results.hypothesis: Pin bar patterns during momentum exhaustion, confirmed by ADX+EMA, signal trend reversals on M5 XAUUSD.
research_results.conclusion: NO EDGE. Fading momentum with pin bars is catastrophic (-162k pips). Win rate 0-2%. Pin bars fire during trend continuation, not reversals — fading them catches falling knives. The descriptive analysis hint (M15 bottom-10% momentum bars 54.4% win rate) was misleading: that was a raw price-return stat, not a tradable signal with stops. REJECTED.

notes: Research script: research/v7_momentum_reversal.py — no MT5 writes, no live trading, no fabrication. All numbers computed from db/trading.db (XAUUSD M15: 47398 bars, M5: 35797 bars).
